title: Adaptive Spectral Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2603.01623v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have become the dominant tool for high-fidelity image and video generation, yet are critically bottlenecked by their inference speed due to the numerous iterative passes of Diffusion Transformers. To reduce the exhaustive compute, recent works resort to the feature caching and reusing scheme that skips network evaluations at selected diffusion steps by using cached features in previous steps. However, their preliminary design solely relies on local approximation, causing errors to grow rapidly with large skips and leading to degraded sample quality at high speedups. In this work, we propose spectral diffusion feature forecaster (Spectrum), a training-free approach that enables global, long-range feature reuse with tightly controlled error. translated_title: 面向扩散采样加速的自适应谱特征预测方法
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为高保真图像与视频生成的主流工具，但由于扩散Transformer需要大量的迭代计算，其推理速度受到了严重瓶颈制约。为了减少庞大的计算开销，近期的研究工作采用了特征缓存与复用方案，通过使用先前步骤中缓存的特征来跳过选定扩散步骤的网络评估。然而，这些初步设计仅依赖于局部近似，导致误差随跳过步数增大而迅速增长，并在高加速比下造成样本质量退化。在这项工作中，我们提出了谱扩散特征预测器，这是一种无需训练的方法，能够实现误差严格可控的全局长程特征复用。具体而言，我们将去噪器的潜在特征视为随时间变化的函数，并用切比雪夫多项式对其进行近似。特别地，我们为每一项拟合系数……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的谱扩散特征预测器Spectrum，利用切比雪夫多项式对去噪器潜在特征随时间的演化进行全局长程建模，实现误差严格可控的跨步特征复用，从而大幅加速扩散模型的采样推理。
en_tdlr: Spectrum is a training-free spectral feature forecasting approach that approximates the temporal evolution of denoiser latent features with Chebyshev polynomials, enabling global long-range feature reuse with tightly controlled error to accelerate diffusion sampling.
